title: Kayak Hotel Rates Scraper
description: Compare Kayak hotel rate groups with room descriptions, booking providers, total prices, and click-through links. Batch hotel IDs and choose future stay dates.

hotels.title: KAYAK hotel IDs
hotels.description: KAYAK hotel identifiers whose provider rates you want to compare.

hotel_id.title: Hotel Id
hotel_id.description: KAYAK hotel identifier used to retrieve property rates or reviews.

checkin.title: Checkin
checkin.description: Hotel check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. When omitted, check-in is set to 30 days from today.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.description: Hotel check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after check-in. When omitted, check-out is set to two days after check-in.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult travelers included in the search.

child_age.title: Child age
child_age.description: Age of one child in the hotel search, from 0 to 17.

price_mode.title: Price Mode
price_mode.description: Whether quoted prices are shown as totals or per-night or per-person values. Accepted values: total, nightly.
